summary: Dereferences the pointer stored at this+0x0 and returns the byte at offset +0x20 of the pointed-to object. Structural twin of FieldAccessorAt0x20 (00404d10); called by ShortComputation_f070 (0x0049F070).

local_names.obj: pointed-to object whose +0x20 byte is read

operations.description: obj = *(DWORD*)this — load the pointer stored at this+0x0.
return *(BYTE*)(obj + 0x20) — byte field at +0x20 of the pointed-to object.
